capabilities: Render gallery code blocks from one or more folder paths, with recursive search or whole-vault mode
Browse media in a lightbox with zoom, panning, thumbnails, and keyboard shortcuts
Play automatic slideshows with a configurable interval and random navigation
Sort galleries by date, name, or random order
Upload and delete media files directly from the gallery
disambiguation: Not a photo-journaling or memory-keeping tool; it renders galleries from whatever media files exist in the folders you point it at.
extras: README covers installation, full code-block configuration reference, supported formats, performance recommendations, and a troubleshooting section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a folder of media files as an interactive gallery inside a note.
summary: Media gallery plugin that renders images, videos, and audio from vault folders into grid galleries in notes via a memories code block.
